title: Support the projects
body: Everything published here — the apps, the plugins, the open-source code — is built in spare hours and kept running out of pocket. If any of it has been useful to you, you can support it with a voluntary donation.

points.voluntary: It is entirely voluntary: you receive nothing in return — no downloads, no perks.
points.free: You choose how much to give, in the currency you prefer.
points.pesos: It is always charged in Chilean pesos (CLP), converted with the Banco Central de Chile's exchange rate.
points.receipt: You get a receipt by email, and the donation appears in your account.

currencies_unavailable: Some currencies are unavailable right now because there is no exchange rate for them. Pesos always work.
amount_placeholder: How much would you like to give?
no_limits: Any amount — there is no minimum and no maximum.

problems.not_positive: The amount has to be more than zero.
problems.decimals: This currency is written with at most {{decimals}} decimals.
problems.decimals_zero: This currency is written without decimals.
problems.below_one_peso: That is less than one Chilean peso once converted.
problems.below_minimum: Converted to pesos, that is below the smallest donation accepted.
problems.above_maximum: Converted to pesos, that is above the largest donation accepted.

sign_in_hint: A donation is tied to an account so it can come with a receipt. Signing in only takes your email, and you will come back to this form.
account_hint: The receipt goes to the email of the account you are signed in with.
provider: Payments are processed securely by MercadoPago.
checkout_failed: The donation could not be started: {{reason}}

return.thanks_body: Your donation of {{amount}} arrived. The receipt is on its way to your email.
return.failed_title: The payment did not go through
return.failed_body: Nothing was charged. You can try again with another payment method whenever you like.
return.pending: Your payment is still being processed. You will get the receipt by email as soon as it is confirmed.
return.signed_out_title: Sign in to see your donation
return.signed_out_body: The status of a donation is only shown to the account that made it.

closed_body: We are not taking donations right now. Thank you for wanting to help; please try again later.
clp_notice: The amount is charged in Chilean pesos (CLP).
clp_notice_converted: You are charged in Chilean pesos (CLP): your {{code}} are converted to pesos with the exchange rate published by the {{source}}, and the CLP figure is what you pay.
message_placeholder: If you like, leave a few words with your donation.
message_hint: Only the author of the projects reads it; it is never published.
voluntary_notice: Your donation is entirely voluntary, and you receive nothing in return.

bounds.between: You can give between {{minimum}} and {{maximum}} (once converted to pesos).
bounds.from: You can give from {{minimum}} (once converted to pesos).
bounds.up_to: You can give up to {{maximum}} (once converted to pesos).
